court: Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of the State of New York

issues.label: Correct jurisdiction/venue for SORA classification
issues.why: Court must confirm it is the proper court to classify given multi-county convictions.

issues.label: Which offenses inform the RAI
issues.why: Board scored only Sullivan County offenses, raising whether all convictions should factor into classification.

issues.label: Accuracy of presumptive point score
issues.why: Court must verify the 100-point RAI scoring supporting the level two presumption is correct.

issues.label: Burden of proof on individual RAI factors
issues.why: People must prove risk factors by clear and convincing evidence.

issues.label: Reliability of evidence relied upon
issues.why: SORA determinations must rest on reliable hearsay such as case summaries and grand jury materials.

issues.label: Legal basis for upward departure
issues.why: Court must identify an aggravating factor not adequately captured by the RAI.

issues.label: Second underage victim as aggravating factor
issues.why: Whether the uncaptured second child victim is a valid, provable ground for departure.

issues.label: Burden and standard for departure
issues.why: People bear burden to prove aggravating circumstances by clear and convincing evidence.

issues.label: Three-step departure analysis
issues.why: Court must apply the required framework identifying factor, proving facts, and weighing totality.

issues.label: Double-counting of scored conduct
issues.why: Departure factor must not duplicate conduct already reflected in the point score.

issues.label: Discretionary weighing of aggravating vs mitigating
issues.why: Even if grounds exist, court must exercise discretion balancing all circumstances.

issues.label: Consideration of any mitigating factors
issues.why: Court must weigh defendant-proffered mitigators before departing upward.

issues.label: Adequacy of stated reasons for departure
issues.why: Court must articulate reasons on the record sufficient for review.

issues.label: Notice of intent to depart
issues.why: Defendant must receive adequate notice that an upward departure is sought.

issues.label: Whether departure factor risks over-punishing
issues.why: Additional victim may relate to seriousness rather than reoffense risk relevant to SORA.

issues.label: Sex offender designation determinations
issues.why: Court noted classification 'without further designation,' implicating predicate/sexually violent/predator findings.

issues.label: Effect of global plea resolution
issues.why: Terms of the negotiated disposition may bear on classification treatment of combined offenses.
